scripts.db:use-postgres: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('prisma/schema.prisma', fs.readFileSync('prisma/schema.prisma','utf8').replace('provider = \"sqlite\"', 'provider = \"postgresql\"')); console.log('✅ Switched to PostgreSQL (Supabase)');"
scripts.db:use-sqlite: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('prisma/schema.prisma', fs.readFileSync('prisma/schema.prisma','utf8').replace('provider = \"postgresql\"', 'provider = \"sqlite\"')); console.log('✅ Switched to SQLite (Local)');"
